name: wttrbar
summary: Weather module for Waybar powered by wttr.in, with a detailed forecast tooltip
description: wttrbar is a small Rust program that prints weather for Waybar's custom module format using wttr.in. The bar shows the current temperature and condition, while the tooltip holds a multi-day hourly forecast. Options cover location, units, AM/PM time, Nerd Font icons, date format and which indicator to show.
